description: Change how the person is told about Offers and checks. Leave out request_id to change their account-wide settings. check_frequency: adaptive, weekly, monthly or never. check_channels: agent_then_email (email after 24 hours unanswered), agent_only or email_only.

agent_reachability.description: Turn email or polling on or off for this Request.

check_channels.description: Who asks: you, then email; only you; or only email.

check_frequency.description: How often the person is asked if they still want it.

offer_alerts.description: Whether the person is emailed new Offers.

request_key.description: Optional. The same key repeats a change safely; one is derived when left out.
